entry_state: Inventory basis transfers precede subsequent sales and recoverable write-downs, without recreating a hedge reserve. Net hedges preserve gross transactions and their different earnings periods. Award expense depends on condition type, settlement rights and current liability valuation. Beneficial amendments retain the original grant cost and add their own service period; cash-to-equity changes follow a separate measured transition. Participation and earnings per share remain to follow.
exit_state: Participation rights allocate earnings before division, and assumed issuance can change both numerator and denominator. The capped fixed-rights family has a restricted additive-gross-effects ordering derivation. Joint bonus and tax consequences invalidate isolated increments, and final selection remains unresolved; contingent options additionally require their similar outstanding instrument prerequisite. Participating-dividend tax benefits have been allocated across three years, with a negative residual adjustment preventing duplication. The final payout-invariance interpretation continues next.
findings: The capped participation case recalculates ordinary allocation after assumed issuance and explains both cap regimes and loss allocation.
The dependent-conversion example gives complete conditional worlds while explicitly leaving the nonadditive dilution selection unresolved.
The contingent option example separates period-end contingency status from the prerequisite exercise of similar outstanding instruments.
The participating-tax example preserves signed residuals when dividends distribute earlier earnings; zeroing the negative adjustment would duplicate a benefit. No new confirmed defect.
